placement.title: Sticker placement
placement.subtitle: Where to put your QR sticker
placement.diagramLabel: Car seen from above, front on the left: 1 boot lid and bumper, 2 rear window, 3 front side windows, 4 windscreen.

rules.body: Safest: outside on the bodywork (e.g. boot lid, bumper) or small, inside a corner of the rear window.
rules.rearWindow: Rear window only if your car has two exterior mirrors. Otherwise only right at the edge, so the view to the rear stays clear.
rules.windscreen: Windscreen: preferably not at all. If you must, only right at the edge outside the field of view and never in the wiper area.
rules.size: Keep it small: well under 0.1 m² and never more than a quarter of a window. Not reflective, not illuminated, never covering number plates, lights or inspection stickers.

placement.print: Printing: at least 30 × 30 mm for scans from about 1 m, larger for longer distances. Leave a white margin of 4 modules (squares) around the code. Matte vinyl, black on white.
placement.disclaimer: Not legal advice. The German StVZO (including §§ 35b, 40) and how the authorities apply it are decisive. Violations can result in a fine.
